answer: Price admission on a spiral. Each epoch the first 25 joins burn 1 POA each, and every join after that doubles the burn, so join 26 burns 2 POA and join 35 burns 1,024. The price resets next epoch. A farm squeezing 40 heads past the first 25 in one epoch burns over 65,000 POA, while spreading them out takes weeks of waiting. A prism view of the join log, split by funding wallet and timing, shows who is crowding the queue. A real agent grows like a pearl, layer by layer; a farm needs speed, and speed is exactly what this taxes.
